newsitem.title: POLAND: EFEKT CUTS 96 NET FORECAST TO PLN 1.9 MLN.
newsitem.headline: EFEKT CUTS 96 NET FORECAST TO PLN 1.9 MLN.

text.p: Polish trader Efekt SA expects to make a net profit this year of 1.9 million zlotys rather than the 3.5 million zlotys it predicted last March, the firm said in a statement on Friday.

Efekt said main reasons for the poorer results included a failed 14.5-million-zloty sugar contract, a weaker-than- expected Polish commodities market, low-profit foreign trade and a delay in starting operations in neighbouring Ukraine.
The firm said it would make a pre-tax profit of 3.2 million zlotys on 18.3 million zlotys in sales this year instead of the 5.9 million zlotys on 27.5 million in sales predicted in March.
Efekt has netted 1.6 million zlotys over this year's first 10 months on a pre-tax profit of 2.8 million zlotys and sales of 14.9 million zlotys.
